'''Giant skeletons''' are found in [[Tarn's Lair]]. They are bigger than [[Skeleton|regular skeletons]] and, based on their examine text, they might have been giants (such as [[Hill Giant]]s) when still alive. They are similar to other [[giant skeleton]]s found in the Shadow Dungeon and Daemonheim.
